title: Planner Scoring Calibration & Target Resolution for Falsification/Defeater Selection
source: Falsification/Defeater Diagnostic (post-D10, 15 FULL_RAPHAEL episodes): 560 falsification discriminators proposed across 5 T4 episodes — 0 selected. 442 defeater triggers generated across all 15 episodes — 0 selected. ContradictionManager and DefeaterGenerator are structurally complete and actively producing candidates. The pipeline breaks at the Planner's decide() method: falsification/defeater candidates never win the scoring comparison against generic scan/recon actions.
defect_statement:
Two defects prevent falsification and defeater components from producing observable outputs:

Defect 1 — Target Resolution Gap (orchestrator/brain/action.py:890-892): The Planner resolves candidate targets to WorldModel entities via world.find_by_identifier(), which searches _by_identifier (IP/hostname → entity_id). However, falsification discriminators pass con.target_entity_id (entity_id strings like 'ent_xxx') as their target, and defeater candidates pass either entity_id or the literal string 'target'. Neither is an IP/hostname, so find_by_identifier() returns None, and the semantic_inference_driven boost (+0.5 at line 897) never fires for these candidates.

Defect 2 — Scoring Calibration (orchestrator/brain/action.py:843-906): Standard scan/recon actions accumulate utility bonuses: +0.35 version detection, +0.3 known entity, +0.2 relationships, +0.5 semantic_inference_driven = 1.35 peak. Falsification candidates get +0.4 (falsification priority at line 844) + 0.2 (concrete action at line 866) = 0.6 base — plus +0.5 if entity resolves. Even with full bonuses (1.10), falsification loses to scans (1.35) when both target the same entity. Defeater candidates receive no special boost at all — only +0.2 concrete action. The Planner rationally prefers comprehensive scanning over targeted epistemic probes.

diagnostic_evidence.confirmed_via: Falsification/Defeater Diagnostic (arena/d10_falsification_defeater_diagnostic.py) run on 15 FULL_RAPHAEL episodes (T3 ×5, T4 ×5, T6 ×5). ContradictionManager.detect_contradictions() produces 100 contradictions across T4 episodes. propose_discriminators() produces 560 discriminators. DefeaterGenerator.generate() produces 442 triggers. All pass D8 scope filter. 0 selected by Planner. 0 FalsificationResult produced. 0 DefeaterResult produced. Root cause confirmed by tracing Planner utility scoring: scan actions consistently outrank falsification/defeater candidates.
diagnostic_evidence.defect_location_1: orchestrator/brain/action.py:890-892 — world.find_by_identifier(c['target']) fails for entity_id or 'target' literal strings
diagnostic_evidence.defect_location_2: orchestrator/brain/action.py:843-906 — falsification/defeater candidates lack sufficient scoring priority relative to scans when linked to active contradictions or defeater triggers
diagnostic_evidence.existing_infrastructure: Planner has access to self.contradiction_manager.get_active_contradictions() and self.contradiction_manager.get_contradictions_for_entity(). WorldModel.get_entity(entity_id) can resolve entity_ids directly. Defeater trigger IDs are carried on defeater candidates via defeater_trigger_id field. Falsification candidates carry _is_falsification=True and target = con.target_entity_id.

change_objective: Recalibrate the Planner's candidate scoring function in decide() to prioritize falsification and defeater actions when linked to active contradictions or defeater conditions. Fix entity target resolution so defeater/falsification candidates receive the same semantic_inference_driven boost as base candidates. The goal is to ensure that when a falsification or defeater candidate is generated, it is selected in at least 1 PlanDecision per episode where it appears, producing measurable FalsificationResult and DefeaterResult objects.
invariant_to_establish: In at least 5/5 T4 episodes (where contradictions are detected), at least 1 falsification candidate is selected and executed, producing FalsificationResult. In at least 5/15 FULL episodes, at least 1 defeater candidate is selected and executed, producing DefeaterResult. D7/D8/D9/D10 invariants remain satisfied.

architectural_constraint.target_resolution: The Planner must resolve entity_id strings (e.g., 'ent_xxx') passed as targets by falsification and defeater candidates into WorldModel entities. If find_by_identifier() returns None, check if target starts with 'ent_' and resolve via world.get_entity(). If target is the literal string 'target', look up entities associated with the active hypothesis via hypothesis_manager.get_hypothesis().entity_ids. This fix lives entirely in action.py — do NOT modify DefeaterGenerator or ContradictionManager.
architectural_constraint.scoring_calibration: Falsification candidates linked to an active contradiction (via contradiction_manager.get_contradictions_for_entity()) must receive sufficient utility to rank >= generic scan/recon actions for that target. Defeater candidates must receive a similar boost. The calibration must be generic: no hardcoding of T3/T4/T6 or specific targets. Use the existing _is_falsification, _is_defeater flags and contradiction_manager state.
architectural_constraint.no_benchmark_optimization: Do not hardcode 'If T3, select falsification' or any template-specific logic. The scoring boost must depend on architectural state (active contradictions, defeater triggers, hypothesis relevance), not scenario identity.
architectural_constraint.no_new_state: Do not add new fields to Planner, PlanDecision, or any component. The calibration uses existing flags (_is_falsification, _is_defeater, defeater_trigger_id), existing methods (contradiction_manager.get_active_contradictions, get_contradictions_for_entity), and existing resolution logic (world.get_entity).
architectural_constraint.single_file_change: All changes are in orchestrator/brain/action.py (Planner.decide() method). If a helper function is needed for target resolution, add it within action.py as a Planner method or module-level function.
architectural_constraint.defeater_target_scope: The literal 'target' string appears in DefeaterTrigger.suggested_target when the trigger does not target a specific known entity (Rules 2-4 in defeater.py). The Planner must handle this gracefully: treat it as 'resolve to first hypothesis entity' rather than failing silently.
architectural_constraint.falsification_contradiction_link: Falsification candidates already carry 'target' = con.target_entity_id. The Planner can check contradiction_manager.get_contradictions_for_entity(target_entity_id) to determine if an active contradiction exists. If yes, the falsification candidate gets an additional boost beyond the current +0.4.
architectural_constraint.no_downstream_changes: CapabilityBroker, SafetyVerifier, Evaluator, WorldModel, HypothesisManager, LLM, FalsificationManager, DefeaterGenerator, DefeaterEvaluator, D7/D8/D9/D10 repair code — NONE may be modified.

change_logic.step_1: Add a helper method _resolve_candidate_target() to Planner (or module-level function in action.py) that attempts three resolution strategies in order: (a) world.find_by_identifier(target) — IP/hostname look-up, (b) world.get_entity(target) if target starts with 'ent_' — entity_id direct look-up, (c) if target is 'target' literal, resolve to first entity associated with active hypotheses via hypothesis_manager. Returns (Entity or None, resolution_method_string).
change_logic.step_2: Replace the inline target resolution block at action.py:890-894 with a call to _resolve_candidate_target(). The entity_id for the semantic_inference_driven boost is now correctly resolved for all candidate types.
change_logic.step_3: Increase the falsification priority boost at action.py:844-845 from +0.4 to a dynamic value: if self.contradiction_manager.get_contradictions_for_entity(target_entity_id) returns active contradictions (status in {DETECTED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION}), add +0.6 (total = 0.4 + 0.6 = 1.0). If no active contradictions exist, keep the existing +0.4. This ensures falsification candidates targeting contradictory entities always have net utility >= 1.0, which exceeds the typical scan utility (~0.85 base, ~1.35 with hypothesis boost).
change_logic.step_4: Add a defeater priority boost at action.py (after the falsification block): if c.get('_is_defeater'), add +0.4 base boost. Additionally, if the defeater candidate targets an entity with an active contradiction, add +0.3. Also check if the defeater_trigger_id is present and not yet evaluated — if the trigger is fresh, add +0.3. This gives defeater candidates a utility floor of 0.4 + 0.2 (concrete) = 0.6, rising to 1.2 with hypothesis boost.
change_logic.step_5: Ensure rationale codes track the new boosts. Add 'falsification_contradiction_resolution' when the falsification boost fires due to active contradiction. Add 'defeater_priority' when the defeater boost fires.
change_logic.step_6: Verify at action.py:945-946 that _is_falsification rationale code is appended AFTER the selected candidate is chosen (this already exists — just verify it captures the new 'falsification_contradiction_resolution' code).
change_logic.step_7: Add analogous check for _is_defeater rationale at action.py (around line 946): if selected.get('_is_defeater'): rationale_codes.append('defeater_priority') and if linked to active contradiction, also append 'defeater_contradiction_resolution'.
change_logic.state_change: No new state. All changes are ephemeral scoring logic within a single method call.

regression_test.description: Re-run the 15 FULL_RAPHAEL episodes (T3, T4, T6 × 5 validation seeds each) from the same schedule as D7-R1/D9/D10. D7/D8/D9/D10 invariants must hold. New D11 invariants: falsification and defeater candidates must be selected and produce outputs.

expectation_1.description: In T4 episodes (where contradictions are detected), at least 1 falsification candidate is selected and executed per episode, producing ≥1 FalsificationResult.
expectation_1.before: 0/5 T4 episodes (0%), 560 discriminators proposed but 0 selected
expectation_1.verification_method: Parse falsification_results from arena_runner after each episode. Count episodes with len(falsification_results) > 0. Also check plan_decisions for 'falsification_priority' or 'falsification_contradiction_resolution' rationale codes.
expectation_1.rationale: D11 directly targets the scoring calibration gap. Once falsification candidates receive sufficient utility relative to scans, the Planner should select them.

expectation_2.description: In FULL_RAPHAEL episodes where defeater triggers are generated (all 15), at least 1 defeater candidate is selected and executed per episode, producing ≥1 DefeaterResult.
expectation_2.verification_method: Parse defeater_results from arena_runner after each episode. Count episodes with len(defeater_results) > 0. Also check plan_decisions for 'defeater_priority' or 'defeater_contradiction_resolution' rationale codes.
expectation_2.rationale: Defeater candidates now receive explicit utility boosts and correct target resolution, making them competitive with scan actions.

expectation_3.action: MUST still hold (0/15). Planner modification does not touch D7 denial lifecycle.
expectation_3.rationale: D7 is unchanged. Denial state machine is in action_registry, not in scoring logic.

expectation_4.action: MUST still hold (0/15). Planner scoring does not modify candidate generation.
expectation_4.rationale: D8 scope filter is upstream of the Planner. Scoring happens after candidates pass the filter.

expectation_5.action: MUST still fire (≥1 per episode). The fix expands entity resolution, making D9 MORE likely to fire, not less.
expectation_5.rationale: D9 depends on entity resolution. The target resolution fix in D11 makes entity resolution succeed for defeater/falsification targets that previously failed.

expectation_6.action: MUST still hold (≥10/15 episodes). D11 does not modify LLM calling code.
expectation_6.rationale: D10 evidence window and prompting repair are untouched.

expectation_7.after: any value (Rule 3 applies — behavioral superiority is not required)
expectation_7.rationale: D11 targets falsification/defeater output, not benchmark score. Score may improve if resolving contradictions helps task completion, but this is not required.

regression_test.execution_restriction: Do not execute regression test until this spec is sealed by SENTINEL

edge_cases.case: Defeater target is literal 'target' with no active hypotheses
edge_cases.behavior: _resolve_candidate_target() tries find_by_identifier('target') → None, get_entity('target') → None, hypothesis_manager fallback → [] → no entity found. The candidate gets no entity-specific bonuses but still receives the base defeater boost (+0.4 + 0.2 concrete = 0.6). It ranks below scans with entity bonuses, which is acceptable — the candidate still exists and may be selected if no higher-utility scan targets exist.
edge_cases.verification: No crash or KeyError. Candidate is scored and ranked. Scan action with entity bonuses is selected instead, which is correct behavior.

edge_cases.case: Falsification candidate targets an entity with no active contradiction (race condition — contradiction was just resolved)
edge_cases.behavior: get_contradictions_for_entity() returns empty list (contradiction status no longer DETECTED/UNDER_INVESTIGATION). Falsification boost stays at +0.4 (no additional +0.6). The falsification candidate may not be selected, which is correct — no need to probe already-resolved contradictions.
edge_cases.verification: Falsification candidate is scored at base priority level. Not selected if scans have higher utility.

edge_cases.case: Multiple falsification candidates exist for the same entity (multiple contradiction types)
edge_cases.behavior: Each falsification candidate gets the +0.6 active-contradiction boost independently (checked per target entity). If they differ in action_type/capability, the highest-utility one is selected first. Subsequent PlanDecisions may select additional falsification candidates until the contradiction is resolved.
edge_cases.verification: At least 1 falsification candidate selected per episode. Selection of multiple is acceptable and may improve contradiction resolution speed.

edge_cases.case: Both falsification and defeater candidates compete for the same entity in the same PlanDecision
edge_cases.behavior: Both receive their respective boosts. Falsification (1.0 + 0.2 + possible SI boost = 1.7) slightly edges defeater (0.4 + 0.3 + 0.2 + SI boost = 1.4). Both are ranked above generic scans. The higher-utility candidate is selected. The other remains in the candidate set for future decisions.
edge_cases.verification: The Planner selects the higher-utility candidate. No crash. The non-selected candidate is available for subsequent decisions in the episode.

edge_cases.case: No active contradictions in the episode (T3, T6 — current detector limitation)
edge_cases.behavior: Falsification gets base +0.4 boost regardless. Defeater gets base +0.4 boost. Both remain lower than scans with entity bonuses. This is acceptable — D12 may fix the T3 contradiction detector to surface the SSH-vs-non-SSH contradiction, at which point falsification will activate for T3 as well.
edge_cases.verification: No crash. Falsification/defeater candidates exist but are not selected (no active contradiction in current episode).

edge_cases.case: Selected falsification action produces no useful evidence (timeout, connection refused, etc.)
edge_cases.behavior: The FalsificationResult is still produced with an INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_TESTABLE outcome. This is valid — it proves the pipeline is live. The contradiction may not be resolved, but the falsification component produced output.
edge_cases.verification: FalsificationResult exists (len > 0). Outcome may be INCONCLUSIVE if the action failed to gather discriminating evidence.
